questions.question: How did the Philistines send the ark back to Israel?
options: Floated down the river on a raft
Loaded onto the backs of donkeys
Carried on the shoulders of priests
On a new cart pulled by two cows
questions.answer: On a new cart pulled by two cows

questions.question: What did they send with the ark as a guilt offering?
options: Silver coins from the city treasury
Live cattle from their own herds
Baskets of grain and fresh fruit
Gold models of tumors and mice
questions.answer: Gold models of tumors and mice

questions.question: The cows pulled the cart straight to Israel without turning, showing God's hand.
The Philistines sent the ark back on a new _____ pulled by two cows.
With the ark they sent golden models of _____ and mice as a guilt offering.
